title: Player Profile folder entity
description: Shape of presets/<mode>/player_profiles/<id>.json. Storage: folder entity. Defines reusable player character profiles for party creation.

itemId.description: Item ID from equipment catalog (relation: kind=equipment).

count.description: Number of items (e.g. ammunition or stackable items).

slotIndex.description: Optional explicit slot index within the container.

contents.description: Items nested inside this container (e.g. arrows in a quiver or gear in a bag).

controlMode.description: Control mode for this character profile (ai or manual).

customSpriteGenre.description: Optional catalog genre for Custom Sprite when different from the mode genre. Empty = mode genre. Controls the catalog list and runtime sprite path for customSprite.

customSprite.description: Optional genre creature catalog id used for watch-mode art for this profile. Wins over the vocation baseSprite. Designer: Select opens the creature catalog filtered by customSpriteGenre (or mode genre). Alpha thumb preview.

skills.description: Standard product skill bag (legacy subtypes): sword, axe, club, fist, distance, shielding, magicLevel, optional fishing. Combat resolve prefers the weapon subtype (e.g. sword when equipping a sword); collapsed melee is derived as max(subtypes) for class-floor fallback only — do not author melee alone on product profiles. Runtime: normalizeSkillBag preserves subtypes, derives melee max, maps magicLevel→magic; used as buildEffectiveStats baseSkills (gear skillBonuses still stack).

stats.description: Combat attributes, imbuements, and leech stats.

lifeLeech.description: Life-leech amount percent. Additive with equipment lifeLeechAmount (pipeline/100).

manaLeech.description: Mana-leech amount percent. Additive with equipment manaLeechAmount (pipeline/100).

critChance.description: Crit chance percent. Additive with equipment critChance (pipeline/100).

critDamage.description: Extra crit damage percent. Additive with equipment critExtraDamage (pipeline/100).

equipment.description: Equipped items by designer slot (relation: kind=equipment). Runtime maps head→helmet, chest→armor, weapon→rightHand, shield→leftHand via normalizeEquipmentMap (Phase 5).

backpack.description: Backpack (not rolled into combat stats). Empty = unset.

inventory.title: Container Inventory
inventory.description: Initial items stored inside equipped containers (e.g. main backpack or quiver in shield/leftHand slot). Supports nested containers.

backpack.title: Backpack Contents
backpack.description: Items starting inside the equipped main backpack.

shield.title: Shield / Quiver Contents
shield.description: Items starting inside a container equipped in the shield/leftHand slot (e.g. arrows in a quiver).

leftHand.title: Left Hand Contents
leftHand.description: Engine alias for shield slot container contents.

weapon.title: Weapon Slot Contents
weapon.description: Items starting inside a container equipped in the weapon/rightHand slot.

rightHand.title: Right Hand Contents
rightHand.description: Engine alias for weapon slot container contents.

backpack.title: Root Backpack Contents (Shorthand)
backpack.description: Shorthand array for items starting inside the main backpack (same as inventory.backpack).
